description: Java source code for DiskLruCache class implementing a filesystem-based LRU cache with journal management, snapshot, and editing capabilities.

classes.name: DiskLruCache
classes.description: Main class implementing a filesystem-based LRU cache with journal management, snapshot, and editing capabilities.

classes.name: DiskLruCache.Snapshot
classes.description: Immutable snapshot of cache entry's data streams.

classes.name: DiskLruCache.Editor
classes.description: Allows editing cache entries, providing input/output streams and commit/abort controls.

classes.name: DiskLruCache.Entry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry with file references, lengths, and state.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens or creates a cache in the specified directory with given app version, value count, and max size.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the cache entry for the given key.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Returns an editor for the specified cache entry, or null if another edit is in progress.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the cache entry for the specified key.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes buffered data to the filesystem.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes all cache data and files.
